effects.printed_clause: Conditional hand Special Summon, then NATURE Special Summon lock for the rest of turn.
effects.lua_implementation: Hand procedure checks empty field or Dragon Xyz; its operation registers CANNOT_SPECIAL_SUMMON for NATURE through End Phase.

official_references.matched_structure: Kashtira Fenrir supplies conditional hand procedure and post-summon restriction structure.

effects.printed_clause: If detached from a Stellaer Xyz to activate its effect: target a Stellaer Xyz you control.
effects.lua_implementation: EVENT_MOVE now catches the material moving from overlay to the GY or banishment; the condition verifies detachment as the activation cost of a Stellaer Xyz Monster before attaching this card.

official_references.matched_structure: Gagaga Ganbara Knight is the official detached-to-activate trigger analogue.

effects.issue: Confirmed and corrected: EVENT_TO_GRAVE did not implement the destination-independent detached wording. Official Gagaga Ganbara Knight and Capshell establish EVENT_MOVE or paired destination events for this condition.

effects.printed_clause: Attach this card as material, but banish it when detached.
effects.lua_implementation: Resolution overlays handler onto target. A target-specific TO_GRAVE_REDIRECT field effect on that Xyz redirects this overlay card to banishment when it would detach to GY.

official_references.matched_structure: Performage Cup Tricker attaches itself to an Xyz as material; official redirect effects handle later detached destination.

effects.printed_clause: The detached effect is once per turn.

official_references.matched_structure: Ash Blossom & Joyous Spring supplies named HOPT structure.

coverage_override.reason: The summon procedure and its resulting Attribute lock are one procedure record; the detached trigger and its leave-field redirect are separately recorded, and the HOPT is included with that activated effect.
